Contributors: M.H. Traubel & Co; O'Connor, R. F.
General-content county map showing towns (townships), hills, rural buildings, and householders' names; the 3 village insets also show buildings and personal names.

General-content county map showing towns (townships), hills, rural buildings, and householders' names; the 3 village insets also show buildings and personal names. Relief shown by hachures. Hand colored to emphasize town (township) boundaries and areas. "Entered according to act of Congress in the year 1854 by R.F. O'Connor in the ... Southern District of New York." Originally printed on 4 sheets (NW/NE/SW/SE). LC copy imperfect: Brittle, shellacked, sheets halved to enable folding, taped at fold lines, stained on cloth backing, hemmed with pink cloth at outer edges (parts missing), southern sheet printed on inside of cloth backing: Livingston Mills 5/4 sheeting [in black] under a red coronal design. Includes local business directory, vignettes of prominent buildings, statistical table (population), embellished outer borders with foliate corner emblazonments, and village insets of Cold Spring/Brewsters/Carmel.
